records.title: Optimal Scheduling Algorithms for LLM Inference: Theory and Practice
records.reason: Develops a theoretical framework for routing and scheduling in two-phase (prefill/decode) LLM inference and proposes the throughput-optimal Resource-Aware Dynamic scheduler plus the SLO-aware SLAI scheduler for time-between-token constraints.

records.title: T WIN KV: A C OMPOSABLE R EPAIR P ASS FOR KV C ACHE E VICTION VIA P AIRWISE K EY R EDUNDANCY
records.reason: TwinKV is a training-free KV cache eviction repair pass that discounts value energy by nonlocal post-RoPE key frequency, beating five compressed baselines on LongBench, LooGLE and RULER at 50-75% KV removal under an exact storage budget.

records.title: ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights
records.reason: ShamAN-Q is a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that replaces NanoQuant diagonal reconstruction geometry with a Shampoo-style Kronecker-factored Fisher Mahalanobis loss, lowering Qwen3 perplexity at about 1 bit per weight.

records.title: PS-SA: An Efficient Self-Attention via Progressive Sampling for User Behavior Sequence Modeling
records.reason: PS-SA progressively samples valuable item pairs to make self-attention efficient for user behavior sequence modeling in recommender systems; a recommender-systems application of sparse attention.

records.title: TagRouter: Learning Route to LLMs through Tags for Open-Domain Text Generation Tasks
records.reason: TagRouter is a training-free tag-based routing method that allocates queries across multiple LLMs, raising system accept rate by 6.15% while reducing serving cost by 17.20% versus 13 baselines.

records.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers
records.reason: Looped Prediction Transformers pretrain looped LMs so only the first recursion writes a KV cache and later recursions read the shared cache plus a short local window, cutting context memory 76-79% at better perplexity.

records.title: SAID: Accelerating Diffusion-Based Language Models via Scaffold-Aware Iterative Decoding
records.reason: SAID reallocates denoising computation across scaffold and detail tokens (plus confidence-hierarchical layered generation) to accelerate diffusion LLM inference up to 9.1x on LLaDA models.

records.title: FoveaTree: Information-Density Trees for Query-Guided Visual Token Pruning in Video Large Language Models
records.reason: FoveaTree is a two-stage training-free visual token pruning framework (merge-gain density quadtree plus attention tree pruning) that reduces the hundreds of per-frame visual tokens driving Video LLM inference cost.

records.title: CIMERA: Compute-in-Interconnect and Memory with Reconfigurable Precision for LLM Inference
records.reason: CIMERA is a reconfigurable-precision LLM inference accelerator integrating compute-in-interconnect and memory to mitigate the memory wall, reporting up to 25x and 10x higher energy efficiency than an H100 for 1B and 13B models.

records.title: Armour: Generalizable Compact Self-Attention for Vision Transformers
records.reason: Armour is a compact, generalizable self-attention mechanism producing smaller and faster vision transformers; an efficient-attention contribution for ViTs rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Routing, Cascades, and User Choice for LLMs
records.reason: Models LLM routing and cascading as a Stackelberg game with a re-prompting user and characterizes provider-optimal versus user-preferred routes; routing policy theory without a serving system implementation.

records.title: ChromFound: Towards A Universal Foundation Model for Single-Cell Chromatin Accessibility Data
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a foundation model for single-cell chromatin accessibility data, a genomics application domain.

records.title: Late-Layer Fusion is Enough: Dual-Path Vision Token Routing for Multimodal Large Language Models under Visual Saturation
records.reason: Dual-Path Vision Token Routing exploits the finding that vision tokens saturate by layer 4 in LLaVA-1.5, routing them through a late-layer-fusion path to remove redundant visual computation in MLLM inference.

records.title: A Novel Shortcut between Local Windows for Window-based Vision Transformers
records.reason: Adds a local-window shortcut with spatial/channel transformations to window-based vision transformers, evaluated on CIFAR100/Tiny-ImageNet classification; a CV architecture tweak.

records.title: GDeR: Safeguarding Efficiency, Balancing, and Robustness via Prototypical Graph Pruning
records.reason: GDeR prunes training data for graph neural networks using prototypical graphs to preserve balance and robustness; training-data curation for GNNs.

records.title: Unifying Convolution and Attention via Convolutional Nearest Neighbors
records.reason: ConvNN unifies convolution and self-attention as k-nearest-neighbor aggregation and validates hybrid layers on ImageNet classification; a computer-vision framework.

records.title: When Is 0.1% Enough? Analyzing the Combined Effects of Dimensionality Reduction and Quantization on Text Embedding Compression
records.reason: Systematically analyzes combined dimensionality reduction and quantization of text embeddings on MTEB, showing near-original scores at under 0.1% storage for classification; an embedding-compression study centered on storage rather than LLM inference execution.

records.title: NeuralZip: Reusable Setup for Fast Lossless Compression
records.reason: NeuralZip losslessly compresses model weight checkpoints by grouping exponent distributions and sharing Huffman codes, making post-setup encoding 1.81-21.33x faster with exact reconstruction; it reduces weight storage/transfer, not inference computation.

records.title: Spatial-Mamba: Effective Visual State Space Models via Structure-Aware State Fusion
records.reason: Spatial-Mamba adds structure-aware state fusion with dilated convolutions so Mamba-style SSMs capture 2D image structure; a vision architecture.

records.title: GCformer: An Efficient Solution for Accurate and Scalable Long-Term Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: GCformer combines a sublinear-complexity global convolution branch with a local transformer branch for long-term multivariate time series forecasting benchmarks; a forecasting task model.
